name: print-social-poster-wall-of-typographic-experiments-in-primary-palettes
title: Wall of typographic posters: BIG BANG, RECTANGLE, FISH, FRAME, LOOK THROUGH, TASTES LIKE and more
whatItIs: A black board with a wall of poster crops in a tight grid: a yellow star bursting behind BIG BANG, blue nested rectangles, blue fish pattern with FISH, yellow rectangles among FRAME and FRAMEWORK, the red hole poster, apple halves, a pink tulip, pink rectangles and more, all with heavy type and small copy.
whatItMeans: Playful and disciplined; each poster is a one-word idea in a shared palette.
techniques: Give each poster one word and one shape.
Keep a shared palette of primaries and cream.
Crop tightly to create a wall.
Use heavy grotesque with tiny body copy.

vocabulary.definition: Many posters shown as a tight collage.
A rule pairing a word with a matching graphic.
A limited colour set across a series.
